meta.description: What happens when an agent fails — retry, fallback, escalate, or graceful degradation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在遇到网络超时、工具错误等失败时会自动尝试重试、改用备用方案、升级处理、输出部分结果或撤销已做工作，让失败变成优雅绕行。
howto.when: 当单个智能体崩溃、超时或输出无效，或智能体间传递丢失上下文，或外部工具/API不可用，或一个失败导致下游失败时触发。

say.text: 操作超时了，我正在尝试用备用方法继续。
我无法访问你的日历，你能检查一下连接吗？
这个任务无法完成，因为天气API暂时不可用。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude automatically applies recovery strategies—retry, fallback, escalate, graceful degradation, or compensation—when failures like timeouts, tool errors, or invalid outputs occur, turning dead ends into detours.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent crashes, times out, or produces invalid output; when context is lost during handoff; when external tools/APIs are unavailable; or when a failure cascades downstream.

say_en.text: Operation timed out. I'm trying an alternative approach.
I can't access your calendar. Can you check the connection?
I can't complete this task because the weather API is temporarily unavailable.
